LogEntries.Entry: Someone at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> wants a package carried to the <Alias=FinalLocation>. The posting says personal, and discreet, twice.
The sender wants a present carried to a woman at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. He would take it himself, but he has tried that twice. He's marked where it is.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.
A man at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> asked me to carry a present to a woman at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. It was real coffee. She's going to thank him herself.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the sender at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're here for the package?
Good. Quickly, before I change my mind.
I'll take the package.
It's by the crates. Don't shake it. And don't tell her it's from me.
Actually, no. Tell her. She'll know anyway.
Why not take it yourself?
Because I'd get there, talk about the weather and come home with it still in my hand. I've done that twice.
Is it fragile?
Only to me.
It's real coffee. Not the stuff we get out here.
She said once she missed it. I don't think she knows I heard.
Why are you nervous?
Because it's for her.
And if she knows how I feel, she's been very polite about it.
Is it you? It's you. Good.
Can I help you?
That's got a ribbon on it. Nobody out here ties ribbons. Is that for me?
It's for you. A present.
Real coffee.
I said that once, on a bad day, months ago. He was listening.
Don't tell him anything. I'll go over myself.
Do you know who it's from?
There's one person who'd ask a stranger to carry this instead of walking it over. So yes.
Were you expecting it?
No.
Hoping, a bit. You don't say that out loud when there are this few of you.
Hello? Is this thing on?
I need something carried to someone, and I'd rather it wasn't me. It isn't far.
